structural_change: r9 STW-S81c-COLLA2-VP 10-22 (after vp8_fb NEEDS_RTL TT -71.5 / FF -37.7 and vp8 EARLY_FAIL_HOLD CTS -25.8; classified C2 clock: GRT closed TT -0.6 / FF +1.0, routed one-root spine 12,983 sinks, insertion TT 871 / FF 702, spread TT 90 / FF 83 (>80); neighbour pairs lfr->lfa, g_hq[0]->[1], k_cfe2->cf, yrow_d split at the 2nd bisection level (~200 ps common) -> 85 ps FF skew; setup cw pin flops -> u_b0 wd_in carries -51 ps skew of -71): clock structure only, RTL/ports/latencies identical to r8: 3 row-band regional roots (OT_SPINE_BANDS=3, ~287 um bands, own bisection subtree each, hung on one centre fork so top/bottom band trunks are equal by construction, band imbalance padded once at the band root) + corner-uniform pad cells (BUFx6f instead of HB4xp67 delay cells, which scale FF/TT unlike the BUFx24 trunk). No RTL band landing: freeze forbids latency changes; band roots are fed from one balanced fork. | prior: r8 ELEM-VP8 10-21 (after r7 3efb91d8d pre-route TT -209/-170: every violator a single-cycle cross-tile wire; clock boundary spread 92 ps): registered relay hops on every long seam (E seam outputs hw/hr/n/m/wl +ER, h round trip +ER+IR with internal y/valid/HSTORE alignment, lane feed + lane output relays in both kits, x extension port request/write +XR at the banks, POST coefficient capture re-registered beside the lanes) and the symmetric insertion-aware clock spine (OT_SPINE_SYM/TREE_PAD/SAFE_BALANCE, tol 8, bins 30, 20 iters; as CLOSED qfd_d2d_static_r8). Outline, pins, macro/lane lattice unchanged. FALLBACK ER=3 IR=2 XR=2: E outputs +3, post_cmd_to_last_hw 63 -> 73, x_qv 4 -> 6 edges after x_rv. | prior: S81-SLICE/VP SAFE 10-21 (after c318a2024 NEEDS_RTL TT -102 / FF -7.8): fault sources registered where they arise (per-lane fault/valid flops, per-row reduce, fold; sticky fault +2..3 edges, diagnostic only); kept copies (<=~40 loads) for every wide select (NORM load decode, bank write-port selects per 32-bit word group, dswp/dodd/xsw2 read muxes, wvl hw_d mux, cf capture one-hot); lr/ly kept per lane (Yosys had merged 4 column copies + hs_d); 33-deep write-back lines -> ring + burst counters. Ports and all data latencies unchanged. Earlier: S81-SLICE (stream 0cm): beat-leaf store + hc_post sub-leaf of the DV slice: command sequencer, 2 x 512x128 leaf-store banks, 16 hard s81sl_hcpl lanes (closed lane_pr re-kit). 10-18: vp op 7 NORMR (hc_pre = leaf row a0, one-step sequencer read) + POST coefficient rows in the G-unit's order (post a0, comb a0+1..a0+4).
